intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Anaheim for 2026, and here is what he found: 12 family events across Anaheim and 1 nearby town, 3 of them free. The magic runs from November 13 (Holidays at the Disneyland Resort, through January 6, 2027), with the Anaheim Town Square Holiday Carnival (November 29), the West Anaheim Holiday Tree Lighting and YMCA Snow Day at Twila Reid Park (December 4) and Monster Jam Christmas Chaos at Angel Stadium (December 19 and 20) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Anaheim

  • 12 Christmas events for kids in Anaheim and Yorba Linda
  • 3 free events: the Anaheim Town Square Holiday Carnival, Santa Visit and Cookies with the Grinch at the Euclid Branch Library and Holiday on Main Street in Old Town Yorba Linda
  • Meet Santa: Santa in the Hills at Anaheim Hills Festival (November 27 to December 23), Santa selfies at the Anaheim Packing House (December 1) and the Nutcracker Holiday Village and Tree Lighting (December 6), plus Santa photos at Holiday on Main Street (December 5)
  • Parades and tree lightings: West Anaheim Holiday Tree Lighting at Twila Reid Park (December 4) and the Nutcracker Holiday Village and Tree Lighting in Downtown Anaheim (December 6)
  • Shows: Fancy Nancy Splendiferous Christmas at Chance Theater (December 4 to 27) and Anaheim Ballet's Nutcracker
  • Trains: none in town; the nearest Christmas train is the Christmas Train at Irvine Park Railroad in Orange, and Amtrak and Metrolink stop at Anaheim ARTIC
  • Season: November 13 to January 6, 2027
